name: wazuh
description: Full Wazuh SIEM integration with one-click agent deployment across your fleet via bastion. Intrusion detection, vulnerability scanning, file integrity monitoring, and compliance checking — all with AI-powered analysis from CommanderQ.
shortDescription: SIEM, vulnerability scanning, and fleet-wide agent deployment.
author: QUOX

wazuhHost.label: Wazuh Server IP
wazuhHost.description: IP address of the Wazuh server. Must be reachable from the bastion.

wazuhPassword.label: API Password
wazuhPassword.description: Wazuh API password. Stored encrypted in QuoxVault.

bastionHost.label: Bastion Host
bastionHost.description: Bastion host used for SSH agent deployment. Defaults to the configured bastion host.

marketingPoints: One-click Wazuh agent deployment to any fleet host via bastion SSH
AI-powered alert triage — CommanderQ analyses and prioritises security events
Vulnerability scanning with actionable remediation commands
File integrity monitoring with change timeline
CIS compliance posture across your entire fleet
Cross-references with QuoxAgent fleet and Uptime Kuma for full situational awareness

agentDeployment.name: Fleet Agent Setup
agentDeployment.description: Deploy Wazuh agents to any host via bastion SSH. No manual installation needed — select hosts, click deploy.

alertFeed.name: Alert Feed & Triage
alertFeed.description: Real-time security alerts with severity levels, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and AI-powered triage.

vulnerabilities.name: Vulnerability Scanner
vulnerabilities.description: CVE detection per host with severity, affected packages, and fix commands.

fileIntegrity.name: File Integrity Monitoring
fileIntegrity.description: Track file changes across hosts. Detect tampering, unauthorised modifications, and rootkits.

compliance.name: Compliance Posture
compliance.description: CIS benchmarks, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR checks with pass/fail scoring per host.

managerHealth.name: Manager Health
managerHealth.description: Wazuh daemon status, event processing stats, and indexer health at a glance.

aiAnalysis.name: AI Analysis
aiAnalysis.description: CommanderQ analyses alert patterns, identifies false positives, and suggests response actions.
